headline: 35 Bangladeshis among 155 foreigners detained in Malaysia's Johor state
summary: The crackdown on undocumented migrants continues as authorities target illegal stays in the region.
details: Authorities in Malaysia's Johor state have detained 155 foreign nationals, including 35 Bangladeshis, during a recent enforcement operation.
The operation targeted individuals suspected of overstaying their visas or lacking valid work permits to remain in the country.
This comes amid a broader push by Malaysian authorities to regulate the labor market and crack down on undocumented migration.
Separately, charges have been filed against six individuals, including a Thai national, for the trafficking of 10 Bangladeshis in Malaysia.
The Malaysian government has also issued an emergency cautionary notice regarding the labor market to alert prospective migrant workers.

headline: Mirpur shooting: Youth placed on 4-day remand after arrest with weapon
summary: A 24-year-old man was arrested with a revolver and ammunition in Mirpur 10, after police responded to reports of gunfire.
details: A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate granted a 4-day remand for Md. Kaushar Bhuiyan, alias Shanto, a 24-year-old man arrested in connection with a shooting incident in Mirpur 10.

The arrest occurred Tuesday night around 9 PM in the Senpara area of Mirpur 10, near the Chourangi Market. Patrol police responded to hearing gunfire and arrested Kaushar with the help of local residents.
Police recovered a six-chamber revolver, four used cartridge shells, and two live cartridges from the suspect. A fragment of a bullet was also seized from the scene.
During initial questioning, Kaushar reportedly admitted to firing at a man named Saiful Islam, alias Siju, due to prior enmity, with the help of an accomplice named Zakir.
The suspect was unable to provide any legal license or documentation for the weapon used in the attack.
Police are now using the remand period to uncover the full mystery of the incident, arrest the remaining accomplice, and identify the source of the the weapon.
caption:
A 24-year-old man is on 4-day remand after being caught with a revolver in Mirpur 10.

A Dhaka metropolitan magistrate granted a 4-day remand for Md. Kaushar Bhuiyan, alias Shanto, a 24-year-old man arrested in connection with a shooting incident in Mirpur 10.

The arrest occurred Tuesday night around 9 PM in the Senpara area of Mirpur 10, near the Chourangi Market. Patrol police responded to hearing gunfire and arrested Kaushar with the help of local residents.

Police recovered a six-chamber revolver, four used cartridge shells, and two live cartridges from the suspect. A fragment of a bullet was also seized from the scene.

During initial questioning, Kaushar reportedly admitted to firing at a man named Saiful Islam, alias Siju, due to prior enmity, with the help of an accomplice named Zakir.

The suspect was unable to provide any legal license or documentation for the weapon used in the attack.

Police are now using the remand period to uncover the full mystery of the incident, arrest the remaining accomplice, and identify the source of the the weapon.
